_meta.note: Captured off the wire: `goose acp` driven over stdio against a model served locally, so no provider credential was involved. Agent-to-client lines in order. Covers the initialize response with agentInfo.version, the session/new response with a sessionId and its modes block, the session/load answer for an id that does not exist (-32002 Resource not found, NOT -32601 -- this harness serves the method), and the empty session/list result. Reductions: session ids replaced with a fixed synthetic value; the provider and model catalog on the session/new result cut to one option per select, because a catalog is an inventory of what the recording host could reach and a corpus pins frame shapes; the session/list result was already empty.
